title_en: Fall 2026 Graduate Thesis Research Course Enrollment Confirmation Submission (Mandatory)
summary: All graduate students registered for Graduate Thesis Research (430.960) in Fall 2026 must submit a course enrollment confirmation between 3 September and 17 September 2026. Students must first complete the Google Form and then submit the attached confirmation form, bearing the advisor's seal, to the staff member in Room 319 (department office, Building 301). Students who do not submit will receive a grade of U.
applies_to: All graduate students who have completed course registration for Graduate Thesis Research (430.960) in Fall 2026. Submission is mandatory.

dates.what: Submission period for the Google Form and the signed confirmation form (all students registered for Graduate Thesis Research 430.960)

conditions: Submission is mandatory for every graduate student registered for Graduate Thesis Research (430.960).
Students who do not submit will receive a grade of U.
The application is complete only when both the Google Form and the paper confirmation form have been submitted.
The confirmation form must include the research content, the thesis title and at least three references, and must not exceed one page.
The confirmation form must bear the advisor's seal (stamp).
In the field for the professor in charge, write the name of the professor whose Thesis Research course you registered for.

Students who registered with a professor other than their advisor must write both the advisor's name and the registered professor's name at the top of the form, and obtain the signature of the professor in charge (registered professor) at the bottom.

Integrated master's-doctoral program students taking two Thesis Research course sections in one semester must obtain the professors' permission in advance and submit a separate confirmation form from each of the two professors.
steps: Complete the Google Form first: https://forms.gle/o1sWaLY5wiaKxsKz7
Download the attached form 'Graduate Thesis Research Course Enrollment Confirmation' (대학원 논문연구 과목수강 확인서) from the original notice.

Fill in the form within one page, including the research content, the thesis title and at least three references, and write the name of the professor whose Thesis Research course you registered for. If you registered with a professor other than your advisor, write both names at the top and obtain that professor's signature at the bottom.
Obtain your advisor's seal (stamp) on the form. Integrated master's-doctoral students taking two sections must have prior permission and obtain a separate form from each professor.
Submit the completed form to the staff member in charge at the department office, Building 301, Room 319, between 3 and 17 September 2026.
translation:
Fall 2026 Graduate Thesis Research Course Enrollment Confirmation Submission (Mandatory)

★ Key information
- Submission period: Thursday 3 September 2026 to Thursday 17 September 2026 (2026. 9. 3.(목) ~ 2026. 9. 17.(목))
- Who must submit: Submission is mandatory for all graduate students who have registered for Graduate Thesis Research (대학원 논문연구, 430.960). (Students who do not submit will be given a grade of U.)
- How to submit: You must complete both 1) and 2) below for your application to be complete.
1) First complete the Google Form: https://forms.gle/o1sWaLY5wiaKxsKz7
2) Fill in the attached confirmation form (including your advisor's seal) and submit it to the staff member in charge in Room 319.

★ Details
- Download the attachment and complete it within one page, including the research content, thesis title and references (at least three).
- For the professor in charge (담당교수), write the name of the professor whose Thesis Research course you registered for.
- Usually students register with their advisor, so the professor in charge is the same as the advisor. However, students who for some reason registered with a professor other than their advisor should write the advisor's name and the registered professor's name separately at the top of the form, and obtain the signature of the professor in charge (registered professor) at the bottom of the form.
- Integrated master's-doctoral program (석박통합과정) students who take two Thesis Research course sections in the same semester must obtain the professors' permission in advance, and must obtain and submit a confirmation form from each of the two professors.

(Note)
- Attachment: Graduate Thesis Research Course Enrollment Confirmation (대학원논문연구 과목수강 확인서_v2.hwp, 33 KB). The content of this attachment was not read; only the text of the notice has been translated.
- The above is a department internal regulation, in effect since Spring 2016.
- Enquiries: Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person and email address are given in the original notice.
